# DODO golden vector provenance

`golden-vectors.json` and `upstream-provenance.json` are **verbatim copies**. They
were not produced by this crate, and the expected values in
`tests/dodo_golden.rs` are never generated by the Rust port.

## Copied from (read-only repository)

| This file | Source path |
| --- | --- |
| `golden-vectors.json` | `mantle-propamm-contracts/test/fixtures/dodo/golden-vectors.json` |
| `upstream-provenance.json` | `mantle-propamm-contracts/test/fixtures/dodo/provenance.json` |

Source repository state at copy time:

* branch `feature/v2-dodo-curve`, HEAD `01a556a`
* the vectors are consumed there by `test/unit/DodoPmmGolden.t.sol` through
  `test/harness/DodoPmmHarness.sol`

That branch has since moved on (HEAD `07f6797`), but both fixture files were
re-verified byte-identical against it — the sha256 values below are the real
anchor, not the commit id.

## Upstream algorithm provenance

* Repository: <https://github.com/DODOEX/contractV2>
* Pinned commit: `8da3ee1ec50966fca9a2c80d424040c45c0f785e`
* Files: `contracts/lib/DecimalMath.sol`, `contracts/lib/DODOMath.sol`,
  `contracts/lib/PMMPricing.sol` (per-file sha256 recorded in
  `upstream-provenance.json`)

The Solidity used to evaluate these vectors is the Mantle vendor copy of those
files (`src/vendor/dodo/…`), which is documented upstream-identical apart from
Solidity 0.8 syntax and checked arithmetic replacing `SafeMath`.

## Pipeline the vectors pin

`DodoPmmHarness._query` / `queryWithFee`:

```text
PMMState{i, K, B, Q, B0, Q0, R}
  -> PMMPricing.adjustedTarget(state)      // records adjustedB0 / adjustedQ0
  -> sellBaseToken(state, amountIn) | sellQuoteToken(state, amountIn)
  -> lpFeeAmount = DecimalMath.mulFloor(grossAmountOut, lpFeeRate)
  -> amountOut   = grossAmountOut - lpFeeAmount
midPrice = getMidPrice(state) after adjustedTarget
```

## Coverage carried by the 19 vectors

* all three `RState` values, both trade directions
* `K = 0`, `K = 1e18`, interior `K`
* both quadratic solvers, `_GeneralIntegrate` on both `K = 0` branches
* return-to-one boundary at `amount - 1`, `amount`, `amount + 1`
* `lpFeeRate` at `0`, interior, and `1e18 - 1`; one-unit fee rounding
* vectors where `adjustedB0 != B0` and where `adjustedQ0 != Q0`
